audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record written to C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\api_group_2026.json; checker reports structure OK, 42 of 42 quotes exact. Walking the deck page by page (dump in full; images of pages 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17) found no term missing from the record, none in the wrong row, and no figure taken from the wrong facility, period or column. All 34 rows keep their status; searches for accordion, transfer, default, prepayment, change of control, reporting, agent, letter of credit and governing-law wording found nothing beyond the disclaimers.

The first auditor's open calls were resolved as follows: guarantor_coverage stays stated; interest cover / other covenants stay 'none' derived from the single-covenant Financial Covenant row; the 281-character page 12 quote stays because it is the only way to carry due 2030, due 2029, $2,157m and the 7-year tenor within three quotes; the repeated one-clause pointer in the negative-covenant rows stays so each by_reference row names what it points to; select_definitions line 1 stays at 254 characters (within 'about 250').

Points the document itself cannot resolve:
1. Whether the '(same as existing Revolving Credit Facility)' tag in the Financial Covenant row covers the 30% springing test or only the acquisition step-up sentence it follows.
2. The step-back after a qualified acquisition is printed as 4.00x, not 3.75x (confirmed on the page image); the deck does not say when or whether the level returns to 3.75x, and 'qualified acquisition' is undefined.
3. Which Term Loan B maturity the 91-day springing maturity runs off: the existing 2029 date or the proposed new 7-year tenor.
4. Whether '>80% of revenue, EBITDA, and assets' is a tested minimum, and whether it describes the guarantors or the listed jurisdictions.
5. Whether the $75m swingline sits inside or on top of the $1,000m.
6. Events of default, mandatory prepayment, transferability, accordion, conditions subsequent and the four reporting rows are silent in the deck. The transaction is an amendment of the existing RCF, so those terms presumably continue, but the deck never says so; they remain not_stated rather than by_reference.
7. Pricing grid, undrawn fee, SOFR floor and upfront fees have no template row and are recorded only in the reviewer notes of facility and lender_commitments, which are not printed.
8. The commitment deadline prints as 'Thursday, May 7th' without a year, as the deck does; the year (2026) comes only from the page 13 calendar heading and is in the note.

doc.title: Revolving Lender Presentation
doc.notes: Lender presentation (slide deck) furnished by Citibank, N.A. as arranger for the amendment, extension and upsize of APi Group's Revolving Credit Facility from $750m to $1.0bn; the cover is dated April 2026 and the company authorization letter April 30, 2026. The terms are a one-page 'Summary of Indicative Terms' on page 11, with context on page 10 (Executive Summary), page 12 (Sources & Uses / Pro Forma Capitalization) and page 13 (Transaction Timeline); pages 1-9 are notices and disclaimers and pages 14-35 are a 1Q'26 update, non-GAAP reconciliations and a contact list. It is an amendment but shows only the proposed terms in a single column (no existing / proposed comparison), marking several as 'same as existing Revolving Credit Facility' and describing negative covenants only as 'similar to existing Revolving Credit Facility'. It gives no detail on covenant baskets, events of default, mandatory prepayments, assignments, conditions or reporting, and does not say that unlisted terms follow the existing facility.

evidence.quote: $1,000 million Senior Secured Revolving Credit Facility and $75 million Swingline Facility
The RCF will also be upsized from $750 million to $1,000 million

facility.note: The Facility row reads '$1,000 million Senior Secured Revolving Credit Facility and $75 million Swingline Facility'; whether the swingline sits inside the $1,000m is not stated. No letter of credit or alternative currency sub-limits are mentioned. Pricing (not a template row): S+125 to S+200 bps on a Net First Lien Leverage grid (>=3.50x S+200; <3.50x & >=2.50x S+175; <2.50x & >=1.50x S+150; <1.50x S+125), undrawn fee 37.5 bps with a 12.5 bps stepdown at First Lien Net Leverage <= 2.75x, SOFR floor 0.00%.

guarantor_coverage.note: Judgement call: the only coverage figure is the '>80% of revenue, EBITDA, and assets' wording in the Guarantors row. It is recorded here as stated, with the caveat that the term sheet does not present it as a tested minimum. The same phrase follows 'collateral located in North America, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and the Netherlands' in the Security row, so it can also be read as describing the share of the group in those jurisdictions rather than the guarantors themselves; the term sheet does not say whose revenue, EBITDA and assets are the denominator. The alternative treatment is not_stated ('None stated in term sheet'). Final review: kept as stated, because the Guarantors row does address the subject of this template row, using the same three measures (revenue, EBITDA, assets) the template asks for.
